query:
SELECT ic.id, ic.client_email, ac.name as ac_name
FROM inspection_charges ic
LEFT JOIN allowed_clients ac ON ac.email = ic.client_email
WHERE ic.client_email LIKE '%vini%' OR ac.name LIKE '%vini%'
LIMIT 10;
